variation: Bilateral bodyweight floor glute bridge; arms by sides, palms down, shoes on.
camera: Slightly elevated side three-quarter, head left, feet right; show both legs and both feet.
equipment: None. No bench, weight, bands or raised platform.
anchors: Head and upper shoulders on floor
reviewNote: Sequence sampling and camera are production choices; no measured anatomy or playback approval is asserted.

frames.label: Set up
frames.cue: Lie back, knees bent, feet planted.
frames.state: Supine; head, shoulders, pelvis, palms and both soles supported. Knees bent; feet hip-width.

frames.label: Begin lift
frames.cue: Brace and lift hips through your heels.
frames.state: Pelvis clears floor slightly; heels, head, shoulders and palms retain contact.

frames.label: Continue lift
frames.cue: Raise hips while keeping your ribs down.
frames.state: Pelvis halfway to shoulder-knee line; hip extension increases without lumbar arch.

frames.label: Top bridge
frames.cue: Align shoulders, hips and knees without arching.
frames.state: Hip line meets shoulder-knee line; head and shoulder support retained, knees follow toes.

frames.label: Controlled lower
frames.cue: Lower your hips slowly under control.
frames.state: Same joint configuration as frame 3 on the controlled return.

frames.label: Finish lowering
frames.cue: Return towards the floor without bouncing.
frames.state: Same joint configuration as frame 2; next frame finishes lowering to floor.
